notes.title: Time to set sail!
notes.content:
Are you ready to set sail? In our last update, we have added some more sea action to our game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36171313/730d6e20ff6009aa5d3097a9964dd3594d04afd5.png[/img]

Sink enemy ships. Or board on them, show your combat skills. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36171313/45a077395b7301425fb5a18b16289140774f3c61.png[/img]

"Tides of Existence" 40% off. The discount will start on 17 February, at 10:00 am. The discount will end on 24 February.
